topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor viruses, proto-oncogenes, and cellular transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the study of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established experimental assays for cellular transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, tumor suppressors, and allele genetics
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications, regulatory pathways, and allele genetics distinguishing oncogenes from tumor suppressor genes.

topics.label: Mechanisms and cellular consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defects in DNA repair, replication, and chromosome segregation generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-step tumorigenesis and hereditary cancer predispositions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the stepwise accumulation of somatic and inherited mutations drives cancer development and tumor progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and provides recommended reading for students.
